# NurdiansyahLabs

> NurdiansyahLabs is a professional portfolio and service platform showcasing expertise in Fullstack Web Development, Data Science, and Data Analytics.

## About
NurdiansyahLabs offers cutting-edge tech solutions, specializing in creating high-performance landing pages, robust fullstack applications, and deriving insights through data analysis and data science methodologies.

## Services & Showcases
- **Fullstack Development**: End-to-end web applications using React, Node.js, PHP, and MySQL.
- **Data Analytics**: Dashboard creation, business intelligence, and trends analysis.
- **Data Science**: Machine learning models and predictive analytics.
- **Landing Pages**: Optimized, high-conversion landing pages for businesses.

- [Trends Dashboard](/trends): Real-time analytics and data visualizations.
- [Services](/service): Detailed breakdown of available consulting and development services.
